text:
Mavis Chen: Heads up — scheduled canary rollout of nvidia-driver 565.12 to us-west1 tonight 23:30 UTC. Started the first batch and a few nodes failed to come back into Ready state.

Alex Torres: Which nodes? any kernel mismatch?

Mavis Chen: gpu-t4-canary-03, gpu-a100-canary-01. Logs show DKMS compile failures and then modprobe can't find the module. Pushing the raw snippet here: 
```
DKMS: build started for nvidia-565/565.12 on kernel 5.15.0-1019-gcp (x86_64)
make: Entering directory '/usr/src/linux-headers-5.15.0-1019-gcp'
cc1: error: unrecognized command line option '-fstack-clash-protection'
Error! Bad return status for module build on kernel: 5.15.0-1019-gcp (x86_64)
Consult /var/lib/dkms/nvidia-565/565.12/build/make.log for more information.
modprobe: FATAL: Module nvidia not found in directory /lib/modules/5.15.0-1019-gcp
```

Priya Nair: I'm seeing the same in staging-us-west yesterday. The dkms/make.log shows gcc 13 flags (from new toolchain image) colliding with kernel build flags. Quick grep: `undefined reference to __stack_chk_fail` in linking stage.

Dan Vogel: ops-bot shows deploy job 3245 failed on 3 hosts, exit code 2. Jobs were using the new package from our apt repo (apt.redwood-inference.net/nvidia/565).

ops-bot: Deploy 3245 -> FAILED on gpu-t4-canary-03,gpu-a100-canary-01,gpu-t4-canary-02 (exit=2). See <https://ci.internal/reports/3245>

Liang Wu: Possible quick mitigations:
- hold the upgrade (apt-mark hold nvidia-driver-565) for the remaining pool
- revert to 550.86 image for canary nodes (we have ami/gcr image tag `drivers-550-stable`)
- or avoid DKMS build by installing prebuilt kernel-module packages (we build kernel-specific debs in our artifact repo)

Sara Kim: Noted a similar but rarer failure in us-east2 on preemptible T4s — only nodes with kernel 5.15.0-1019-gcp and the older initramfs generator had the DKMS path. A100 nodes with 5.18 worked fine. So this looks kernel/toolchain-dependent, not strictly hardware.

Alex Torres: Can we patch the DKMS package to skip building on kernels older than 5.18 (temporary)? Or ship a fallback binary module for 5.15 kernels?

Priya Nair: We can produce a fallback `.deb` that contains prebuilt modules for 5.15. I'll start a build for 5.15 and 5.18. But it will take ~40m to create and verify.

Dan Vogel: For immediate ops, I'm going to pause the remainder of the rollout and mark the canary group as blocked. Requeue will be manual after we confirm fix.

Mavis Chen: Sounds good. Action items:
- Dan: pause rollout and blacklist canary image tag (done)
- Priya: publish fallback debs for 5.15/5.18 and post checksum link here (ETA 40m)
- Liang: prepare a quick playbook to apt-mark hold and revert any drifted nodes back to `drivers-550-stable` image (can do in 15m)
- Sara: sweep us-east2/preemptible pool for impacted nodes and cordon any failing ones

Liang Wu: I'll also prepare a short PR to change our packaging pipeline: prefer prebuilt kernel modules in our apt repo and make DKMS an opt-in (so future toolchain upgrades don't trigger DKMS rebuilds unexpectedly).

Priya Nair: Building now. Uploading artifacts to `gs://redwood-artifacts/drivers/565/fallback/` when done.

Sara Kim: quick datapoint — rolling back canary to drivers-550-stable brought gpu-t4-canary-03 back to Ready in ~90s.

Alex Torres: Thanks. Once Priya posts the fallback packages let's test on 2 nodes and then decide to either resume with the prebuilt deb or revert entirely.

ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INF-2026 - driver 565 DKMS failures on kernels 5.15 (link: <https://issues.internal/INF-2026>)

Mavis Chen: OK, keep updates here. Ping me @Mavis if you need permission to rollback further. :thumbsup:

Dan Vogel: I've paused the canary rollout and opened a rollback runbook. Kicking off node-sweep for other clusters now.

Priya Nair: Uploaded fallback DEBs: gs://redwood-artifacts/drivers/565/fallback/nvidia-565-5.15.deb (sha256: abc123...) and nvidia-565-5.18.deb (sha256: def456...). Testing on gpu-t4-canary-04 now.

Mavis Chen: Great — if tests pass, we'll re-run rollout with prebuilt packages only. If not, full rollback to 550 across canary.

Alex Torres: test node back to Ready with fallback deb installed. No dkms build step was triggered, module loaded fine.

Mavis Chen: Closing loop: proceed with staged rollout using prebuilt debs and keep DKMS off by default. Follow-up: PR from Liang for packaging change and a postmortem in INF-2026.

Sara Kim: filing short AAR in the ticket with kernel mix map.

Dan Vogel: ack.

Mavis Chen: Thanks everyone.
